page.meta_description: Mercutio is the kinsman of the Prince who mocks Romeo's love, speaks the Queen Mab fantasy, and dies cursing both houses after Tybalt's thrust. Related…
page.content:
Romeo's friend whose Queen Mab speech and death turn the play.

How Mercutio connects

  • Work: Romeo and Juliet — Mercutio is Romeo's friend whose death turns the comedy toward the tomb.

What is Mercutio?

Mercutio is the kinsman of the Prince who mocks Romeo's love, speaks the Queen Mab fantasy, and dies cursing both houses after Tybalt's thrust.

Key threads lead to Romeo and Juliet.
